about: Decision 0019 (and 0008): LPC cells reduced by Ariel's PixiPPL reducer, 64 to 41 pixels inside a 48-pixel frame at (3, 0). Each layer keeps its alpha until the layers are composited; the finished character then takes binary alpha at 128. Copied from DanJen Delver (vendor/pixippl-resizer/current-settings.json sha256 60fdeb86ed9cf2db8e932b39cbdc8cd22ad67a979b72eebd11fbd29aeab61ba5, assets/lpc/derivative-settings.json version 2), so the output matches its reduced cache.
